scientific.integrity: The source question and classification metadata were independently inspected. The new claim is proved symbolically from exact regular-polygon formulas; the finite scan is only a regression check.
limitations: The theorem optimizes only over finite regular polygons and their disk limit, not all planar convex bodies.
It does not determine the global sharp constant c(alpha) from the motivating source question.
Historical novelty retains a residual risk from unindexed observations based on classical regular-polygon formulas.

title: Square–disk envelope for the area–diameter functional on regular polygons
